findings.text: The held listing stamps siblings once per directory change, so a sibling rewritten in place that comes to claim an idle slug is not refused until the directory moves, where the base revision refused it immediately; production plan writes publish through a sibling temporary (reckon/_store.py:628) and so move the directory, leaving the gap to out-of-band in-place writes.

The assertion compares the file on disk to the exact text the fixture wrote, exercising no reckon code, so it cannot fail on a regression in the change; the preceding `second["title"]` assertion at line 157 is the one that guards the in-place rewrite.
The assertion message is truncated mid-sentence locally ("so this case no longer... "), so a failure reports an incomplete reason.

item_verdicts.call_sites: reckon/resources.py:794 _canonical_identity_is_unique reaches the change through _directory_identity_index; it is called from resolve_resource and read_plan_record, which reckon/serve.py:2438, reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:1847 and reckon/roadmap.py:199 call in production.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit 97afbae9 against ae34dd6f; it replaces per-resolve stamping with a file_memo-held listing, adds three tests, and rewrites the pinned regression test.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_warm_read_stats_what_it_resolves.py; after_suite-1795334988358421515.log records 61 passed and EXIT=0 at 97afbae9, and arm-head.log records warm 12 in both stores.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to bound a warm plan read's stat calls by the plans it resolves; reckon/resources.py:819 holds the directory listing against the directory's own signature.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records base 32/212 against head 12/12, both suite arms green with logs and closing EXIT lines, and the negative control's red.
item_verdicts.write_paths: declared reckon/resources.py and the new test; the diff also edits tests/test_plan_resolution_reads_the_directory_once_per_change.py, which is outside the declaration and recorded under outside_scope.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_warm_read_stats_what_it_resolves.py:141 asserts small_warm == large_warm and the negative-control log reddens on exactly that line when the base stamping is reinstated, so the guard fails on the regression it exists to catch.
justifications.evidence: arm-head.log records warm 12 in both a twenty-plan and a two-hundred-plan store while arm-base.log records 32 and 212, and after_suite-1795334988358421515.log ends in a 61-passing summary and EXIT=0.
justifications.fit: reckon/resources.py:819 follows the surrounding idiom and names mechanisms only, with no plan, stage or ticket identifier in a path, symbol or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/resources.py:819 holds the plans-directory listing against the directory's own signature so a warm read stamps only the plans it resolves, as the goal states.
justifications.reuse: reckon/resources.py:832 delegates holding the listing to the existing file_memo.memoized owner rather than forking a second cache beside it, and the bespoke _ENTRY_NAMES dict is deleted.
justifications.scope_discipline: tests/test_plan_resolution_reads_the_directory_once_per_change.py is edited outside the declared write paths, though the change records it under outside_scope and no merge-refused path is touched.
